goal: Make Lane read and scope refusals actionable without changing authority, while preserving existing authorized same-run recovery under S2 of docs/specs/workflow-execution-reliability.spec.md.

acceptance.assertion: Source E3; meet S2 and SCN-2 in docs/specs/workflow-execution-reliability.spec.md: an injected projection read failure is classified as unreadable, contract mismatch remains distinct and missing ownership parks without declaring completion. Matching active/done runs resume only after the existing fresh authorization; absent authorization, wrong run, changed plan and retired batch do not enroll or commit another run.

Source E4; meet S2 in docs/specs/workflow-execution-reliability.spec.md: out-of-scope and unsupported-index-flag commit refusals stay fail-closed and expose bounded escaped cause, relative path and applicable flag details. Newline/tab filenames and oversized lists are safely encoded with explicit omitted counts; raw verifier output, exception stacks, environment and file contents are not persisted.
